claims.head: Who drives the play: the Senators
claims.body: The Senators have been near the top of the league at controlling the chances at 5-on-5, and the Islanders around the middle. Expect the Senators to spend more of the night in the Islanders’ end. That’s about the puck, not the scoreboard: goalies and finishing decide plenty of games the chances don’t.

claims.head: Depth vs. Star power
claims.body: On depth, the Islanders are one of the league’s best, but Ottawa is one of the worst. They’re about as far apart as two teams get. If this one comes down to the bottom six, that suits the Islanders.

OTT.head: The Senators should have the upper hand
OTT.body: Ottawa has been out-chancing opponents lately and has home-ice advantage. The Islanders can make it interesting if they keep shots to a minimum.

NYI.head: The Islanders have a hill to climb
NYI.body: Ottawa has been out-chancing opponents lately and has home-ice advantage. The Islanders’ best way through is keeping shots to a minimum.

story.head: Who drives the play: the Senators
paras: The Islanders come in at 3-3-0, the Senators at 5-2-0.
